name: Parcel
author: Daniel Zuccon
description: Your Parcel app deliveries in the Omarchy bar: a status-tinted badge, active shipments with ETAs, event timelines, and desktop notifications when a parcel moves.

barWidget.description: Deliveries tracked in the Parcel app (parcelapp.net), read through its Premium API. Badge shows the count and the most urgent state; the panel lists shipments, ETAs and checkpoint timelines.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Parcel allows 20 requests per hour. 300 s is the floor; manual refreshes count too.

schema.label: Deliveries to show
schema.description: active = in progress only. recent = also includes recently delivered parcels.

schema.label: Notify on status change
schema.description: Desktop notification when a parcel changes state, e.g. goes out for delivery.

schema.label: Hide badge when nothing is active
